blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Pasay City government announced that it will implement a partial lockdown starting Saturday, Oct. 24, ahead of the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Leaders’ Summit in November. In an advisory, the local government said it would temporarily ban public activities, events, fun runs, and other outdoor gatherings around the Philippine International Convention Center along Roxas Boulevard and other affected areas from Oct. 24 to Nov. 20. “This aims to ensure proper traffic management, security, and public safety,” it said.
